001: What kind of music do you like the most?
Well, I love jazz, especially for relaxing.
How interesting! I prefer pop, but jazz seems very elegant to me.
Really? Well, you should come with me to a concert sometime.
I would love to, it's been a while since I've been to one.
Great, then I'll let you know when there's something good.
002: Do you feel like watching a movie tonight?
It depends, what genre do you prefer?
I really like thrillers, but I also like comedies.
Well, thrillers make me very nervous, I prefer comedies.
Okay, then let's pick a comedy for both of us.
Sounds perfect to me! That way we'll have a fun time.
003: I don't know what to order, what do you prefer, meat or fish?
I usually choose fish, it feels lighter to me.
It's the opposite for me, I'm more into meat.
Well, we could order one dish of each and share.
Good idea! That way we get to try both things.
Sounds great to me, let's do that.
004: What do you prefer to do on the weekends?
I really like going for walks in the countryside if the weather is nice.
That's nice, I also enjoy the outdoors, but I prefer the mountains.
Well, one day we could meet up to do a hiking route together.
Sounds great to me, I know a very beautiful route.
Perfect! Well, let's leave it planned.
005: Do you like coffee or do you only have it once in a while?
Honestly, I love it, but I only have it in the morning.
I can't have it at night, it keeps me awake.
It's the same for me, that's why I saved it for the mornings.
That's the best thing, that way your rest doesn't get ruined.
Definitely, you have to take care of your sleep.
006: What kind of books do you prefer to read?
I really like historical novels, they transport me to another era.
It's something similar for me, but with science fiction.
Oh, really? Well, I've never tried that genre.
You should give it a chance, it will surprise you.
Well, I'll keep that in mind for my next read.
007: Do you prefer working in a team or alone?
It depends on the project, but usually I like working in a team more.
I find it easier to concentrate when I work alone.
I understand, everyone has their own way of working.
Yes, but I also value other people's ideas.
Of course, in the end what matters is the result.
008: What do you like more, summer or winter?
I prefer summer, I love the heat and the long days.
Well, I'm the complete opposite, I like the cold more.
Really? Well, I don't know how you do it, I suffer with the cold.
I like bundling up and having hot drinks.
Well, everyone has their own tastes, right?
009: Do you like cooking or do you prefer eating out?
I love cooking, but during the week I don't have time.
It's the opposite for me, I cook almost every day.
Well, that's very admirable, I end up ordering food.
It's a matter of getting organized, but I understand it's hard.
Yeah, honestly it requires a lot of consistency.
010: What do you prefer, going to the beach or the pool?
I prefer the beach, I like feeling the sea breeze.
I find the sand a bit annoying, so I choose the pool.
Ha, ha, I understand, the sand gets everywhere.
And then you have to shower and change, it's a hassle.
Well, but swimming in the sea is incomparable.
